title: Spreadsheet
description: One sheet of an Excel workbook from the data (.xlsx bytes), printed as a native table with the sheet's widths, merges, fills, fonts and number formats, formulas evaluated where the file cached no value. Put it in a section with the page the sheet prints on (tabloid landscape for 17 x 11 in). A workbook the data lacks prints a placeholder box and is listed.

sheet.description: The tab name, or its 0-based position; the first visible sheet when null.

range.description: An A1 range (A1:F60); the print area, else the used cells, when null.

headerRows.description: Leading rows repeated on each page; the sheet's print titles or frozen rows when null.

formulas.description: cached: the file's values, evaluating formulas without one; evaluate: every formula.

scale.description: Print scale, percent; the sheet's own (fit to width when it asks) when null.
